authorial_core.interpreted_intent: The continuing request asks to test the added school-life appearance and pose topic. I independently choose a home-economics practical ending: an adult fictional student character releases an apron fastening after producing bread. The completed tray, flour-marked apron and loosening waist ties should connect productive concentration to relief, giving the garment state a reason within school life. I compared blazer-fastening at a doorway and lab-cuff preparation; this completed-task moment connects a garment change and a visible result with less explanation. Fictional adulthood, uniform cut, baking task, knot action, expression, camera and light are authorial choices, not requester facts or claims about the reference person. Saved sensual=1 supports a quietly appealing, unguarded presence; fetish=0 and surreal=0 add no such treatment; creativity=1 invites restrained later alternatives. Reference is used for visible face and hair cues only; actual identity, age and personality are unknown.
authorial_core.subject: A fictional adult woman portraying a student character with face/hair visual cues from the supplied photograph.
authorial_core.setting: A home-economics classroom after a baking practical.
authorial_core.event: An apron fastening loosens as its wearer checks completed bread at the end of the practical.
visual_priorities: Her two hands, the front apron knot and the slackening tie loop read as one connected clothing action.

authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: Make a school-life photograph of a student character, capturing a moment of school life at the end of a baking practical. A fictional adult woman stands beside her workbench in a home-economics classroom, wearing a white school blouse with sleeves folded to the elbows, a narrow navy neck ribbon, and a navy pleated uniform skirt. A pale blue cotton bib apron lies over the uniform, its waist ties wrapped forward and knotted at the front; flour on the apron and a tray of golden bread cooling beside her connect her clothing to the work she has just finished. Use the supplied photograph as the visual guide for her facial appearance and hair: a dark chin-length bob, separated wispy fringe, brown eyes, and a softly rounded facial contour. Render her as this fictional character in the new scene. Her left hand steadies the front waist knot while her right hand draws one loose tie sideways through the bow; the slackening loop and both fingers meeting the apron ties are clearly visible together. Her elbows remain comfortably beside her waist, shoulders lowered, weight settled through both legs. She glances from the knot toward the cooling bread with a small, relieved smile, as if checking the result before finally taking a break. The apron still hangs from its neck strap and covers the front of her skirt as the waist fastening loosens. Behind her, school worktables, stools and a chalkboard with a simple baking diagram establish the class setting. A vertical knees-up photograph from a gently frontal three-quarter position keeps her face, both forearms, waist fastening and bread tray in the same clear view. Soft afternoon window light gives her face and rumpled cotton a tactile warmth; the hands and loosened knot carry the transition from concentration to ease, with the classroom receding quietly behind her.
